title: Temporal Wonder Integration Manifest
description: Declarative DAG manifest describing integration workflows, execution steps, and migration targets in Temporal.

identifier.description: Unique machine-readable identifier for the integration manifest (e.g., 'krt-0000a-1').

version.description: Semantic version of this integration workflow definition.

title.description: Human-readable title describing the integration workflow.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the workflow purpose and business context.

is_active.description: Whether this integration workflow is enabled for orchestration.

system_options.description: Platform-level options (e.g., folder paths, storage account references).

trigger.description: Trigger definition that initiates the workflow DAG.

name.description: Descriptive name of the trigger or source workflow.

steps.description: List of pipeline steps constituting the workflow DAG.

id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the manifest DAG.

type.description: Execution type: 'legacy_logic_app' for Strangler Fig delegation or 'native' for modern activities.

action.description: Activity identifier or legacy Logic App configuration name.

dependsOn.description: List of step IDs that must complete before this step executes.

parameters.description: Step inputs, configurations, and payload templates.

Condition.description: Execution precondition evaluated before scheduling the step.

source.description: Path to variable or input field (e.g., 'form_item.dataValues.WebsakArkivKode').

value.description: Target comparison value or list of values.

initialInterval.description: Initial retry interval in seconds or ISO duration (e.g., '1s' or 1).

backoffCoefficient.description: Rate at which retry interval increases (default 2.0).

maximumInterval.description: Maximum retry interval in seconds or ISO duration.

nonRetryableErrorTypes.description: List of error types that should not trigger a retry.

startToCloseTimeout.description: Maximum execution time for a single activity attempt.

scheduleToCloseTimeout.description: Maximum total time from schedule to completion across all retries.

heartbeatTimeout.description: Maximum interval between activity progress heartbeats.
